purpose: Public-v0.1 live-model release gate. Thresholds are committed before any provider-backed result is observed and must not be relaxed to rescue a failing run.

interpretation.activation_failure: Inspect the miss. Tune skill descriptions only when the miss demonstrates a real activation boundary problem; do not edit the frozen corpus to improve the score.
interpretation.composition_failure: Inspect whether the composition contract is over-broad or the model failed to select a distinct obligation. Do not add doctrine merely to improve a score.
interpretation.behavioral_lexical_failure: Lexical failure is a review trigger, not automatic semantic failure. Review the raw answer against the skill rule and falsifier before changing a skill.
interpretation.pass: A threshold pass is necessary but not sufficient for a public behavioral claim. Material misses still require semantic review.
